name: plain-prose
title_zh: 删掉「值得注意的是」的 AI 腔校对员
tagline_zh: 交稿前总被说「像 ChatGPT 写的」？它逐句扫掉空洞连接词、伪强调和翻译腔，英俄德三语都管，改完像人话。
tagline_en: Tired of being told it reads like ChatGPT? It strips hollow connectors, fake emphasis, and.
desc_en: Audit and rewrite text to remove AI writing patterns. Use when drafting, editing or reviewing prose, or when asked to clean up AI-isms, remove AI tells, or make text sound less like AI. Covers English, Russian and German.
why_zh: 不是换词表，是按语言习惯重写节奏：删掉 AI 爱用的过渡句和对称结构，保留你的原意，让文本恢复自然呼吸。
why_en: Not a synonym swap—it rewrites rhythm per language, cutting AI-favorite transitions and symmetry while keeping your meaning.
limit_zh: 只处理成段文字，不碰代码、数据表或诗歌；对刻意模仿 AI 的戏仿文本无效；需联网调用模型，离线不可用。
limit_en: Prose only—no code, tables, or verse. Won't touch deliberate AI parody. Requires network for model calls. Always fact-check after rewrite.
